questions.prompt:
In mathematics, the product of the first $n$ positive integers is written as $n!=n\times(n-1)\times\cdots\times1$. For example, $2!=2\times1$ and $7!=7\times6\times5\times4\times3\times2\times1$. Evaluate:

$$9+(8+7)\times(6!\div5-4-3-2-1)$$
Which of the following is correct?
The highest common factor (HCF) of two positive integers is 3. If the sum of the two integers is 21, which could NOT be their least common multiple (LCM)?
If the five-digit number $\overline{5D68D}$ is divisible by 36, find the value of $D$.
If $X=0.0000125$ and $Y=0.00008$, which of the following has the greatest value?
The price of an ice cream cone in a shop has increased by 20%. How many ice cream cones can now be bought using the amount of money that used to buy 60 ice cream cones?

The following calculations lead to the conclusion that $\pi>2019$.

Let $x=\pi\ (3.14159\ldots)$, $y=3$ and $z=2019$.  (1)

$-x\le-y$ and $z-y>0$.  (2)

$x\ge y$ and $z>y$.  (3)

Then $x\ge z$.  (4)

Therefore $\pi>2019$.  (5)

Which of the following transition steps is the first that contains an error?
Consider all the integers from 1 to 200. Which of the following is NOT true about them?

choices.text: The sum of all even numbers is greater than the sum of all odd numbers.
Writing all the digits, the digit 0 is the least occurring digit.
The average of the even numbers is greater than the average of the odd numbers.
(Sum of all even numbers) $-$ (Sum of all odd numbers) $=200$
The average of the 200 numbers is not a positive integer.

questions.prompt: Which cube below will be formed when the net in the picture is folded?
How many consecutive zeros are there at the end of $2^{11}\times3^7\times5^5\times7^3\times11^2$?

The sum of the speeds of two cyclists is 34 km/h. If the first cyclist cycles for 3 hours and the second cyclist cycles for 7 hours, then the total distance they travel will be 150 km. Assuming both cyclists cycle at a constant rate, what is the difference between their speeds?
Find the value of $\left[\sqrt{1+2+3+\cdots+100}\right]$, where $[x]$ is the greatest integer less than or equal to $x$. For example, $[13.54]=13$.
Which of the following fractions is the largest?

A leader asked his 6 followers what is inside the gift box he saw. These 6 followers are sitting around a table. Two of them are truth-tellers and they are sitting next to each other. Two followers are liars and they are sitting next to each other as well. Each of the remaining two followers is either a truth-teller or liar, and they are not sitting next to each other. The responses of the followers are shown in the picture.

What is inside the gift box?
In the diagram, $ABCD$ is a square with $AB=20$ cm, $AD$ is a diameter of the semicircle, and $AB$ is a radius of the quadrant. Find the area (in $\text{cm}^2$) of the shaded region.
How many triangles are there in the diagram?

The bar chart below shows the time Lou spent in the gym last week. The average time of the first 3 days was 72% of the average time of the last 4 days. Given the total time spent in the gym last week was 183 minutes, how long, in minutes, did he spend in the gym last week on Wednesday? (Round off your answer to the nearest integer.)
questions.reviewNote: The bar for Wednesday in the printed chart and the label 32 are not used by the official solution; the answer follows from the first two days, the 72% condition and the total of 183.

questions.prompt: What is the remainder when $2018!+13$ is divided by 2019?

The operator $\otimes$ acts on two numbers to give the following outcomes:

$$2\otimes 6 = 44,\quad 4\otimes 10 = 87,\quad 8\otimes 18 = 1613,\quad 16\otimes 22 = 2019.$$

Find the value of $7\otimes 9$.

In a camp, 134 students received a burger and 62 received an ice cream. Fifteen students received burger and ice cream but not fries, and 31 students received all the three types of food. Given there are 200 students in this camp, what is the largest possible number of students who didn't get any of the three types of food?
The number $X$ is a composite number with all different digits, and the product of its digits is 360. What is the greatest possible value of $\dfrac{X}{10}$? (Round off to the nearest integer.)

Evaluate

$$15120\times\left(\frac{2}{1\times2\times3}+\frac{3}{1\times2\times3\times4}+\cdots+\frac{6}{1\times2\times3\times\cdots\times7}\right)$$
The large rectangle below is made up of 4 rectangles with their areas indicated in the diagram. What is the area, in $\text{cm}^2$, of the shaded region?

In the equation below, $a$, $b$ and $c$ are digits, $\overline{aa}$ and $\overline{bb}$ are two-digit numbers, and $\overline{cccc}$ is a four-digit number.

$$\overline{aa}^2+\overline{bb}=\overline{cccc}$$

What is the largest possible value of $a+b+c$?

Find the value of the following.

$$2020\times20-20\times20+2020$$
Simplify $3^1\times3^3\times3^5\times3^7\times3^9\times3^{11}\times3^{13}\times3^{15}\times3^{17}\times\left(\dfrac13\right)^{75}$.
Which of the following is equal to $ax-2by+3c$ if $x=3a-4b^2$, $y=4b-3c^2$ and $z=-2bc$?

Find the value of $N$ in the equation below.

$$\frac{1+2+3+\cdots+120}{110}=\frac{2+4+6+N}{2}$$
A large rectangle in the figure below is divided into nine smaller rectangles. The areas of five rectangles have been given. What is the sum of the areas of the remaining four rectangles?
Denote $n\,\triangle\, m=(n-1)(n-2)\cdots(n-m)$. For example, $5\,\triangle\,3=4\times3\times2$. If $8\,\triangle\,x=840$, what is the value of $x\,\triangle\,(x-3)$?
The value of $\dfrac{2022^3-2\times2022^2-2020}{2021^3+2\times2021^2-2023}$ can be written as $\dfrac ab$ where $\operatorname{HCF}(a,b)=1$. What is the value of $a+b$?
If $x<-4$, simplify the expression $\left|1-\sqrt{(x+3)^2}\right|$.

In the figure below, $HE$ is parallel to $DB$, $GE$ is perpendicular to $BG$, and $DF$ is also perpendicular to $HF$. If $\angle H=138^\circ$, and the measurement of $\angle B$ is 4 degrees more than the measurement of $\angle D$, find the measurement of $\angle E$.

In the list below, how many fractions are in their simplest form?

$$\frac1{2020},\ \frac2{2020},\ \frac3{2020},\ \ldots,\ \frac{199}{2020},\ \frac{200}{2020}$$

Boris wants to write all five-digit numbers using all the digits 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5. The numbers are such that the even digits are in increasing order from left to right, for example 32145 and 25341. How many numbers can Boris write?

In quadrilateral $ABCD$, $M$ and $N$ are midpoints of sides $AB$ and $DC$, respectively. The segments $AN$, $BN$, $DM$ and $CM$ divide the quadrilateral into 7 parts $S_1,S_2,S_3,S_4,S_5,S_6$ and $S_7$ of different areas. Which of the following relationships involving the areas is true?
If today is Tuesday, what day of the week will it be $2^{2020}$ days from today?

Ellie, Violet, Audrey, Tom and Chris are Secondary 1 or 3 students. They study in either Greenwich Secondary School or Westwood Secondary School. It is also given that:

- Tom and Chris are from different schools.
- Ellie and Audrey go to the same school.
- Three students go to Greenwich Secondary School and the other two are from Westwood Secondary School.
- Violet and Chris are from the same grade.
- Audrey and Tom study at different levels.
- Three students study in Secondary 1 and the other two students in Secondary 3.

If one of them is a Secondary 3 student from Westwood Secondary School, who is that person?

In mathematics, the product of the first $n$ positive integers is written as $n!=n\times(n-1)\times\cdots\times1$. For example, $2!=2\times1$ and $7!=7\times6\times5\times4\times3\times2\times1$. How many integers from 1 to 40 cannot be the number of consecutive digit "0"s at the end of $n!$, for some integer $n$?

The following bar chart shows the responses made by all Secondary 2 students from Integrity Secondary School in a multiple-choice question. All the horizontal lines are equally spaced. The correct answer scores 2 points, 0 points for no response and $-1$ point for the wrong answer. The total points scored by all the students is $-240$. If the correct answer is B, how many students solved the question correctly?
How many squares are there in the figure below?

Chloe and her cousin left home for the cinema at 11.40 a.m. Chloe walked at 100 metres/minute while her cousin walked at 60 m/min. Ten minutes after arriving at the cinema, Chloe realised she had forgotten her wallet and so she walked back home. On her way home, Chloe met her cousin, who was still on the way to the cinema, at 12.10 p.m. How far away was Chloe's home from the cinema, in metres?
Find the sum of all positive integers $n$ so that $n^2+11n+52$ is a perfect square.
The six-digit number $\overline{7A34B4}$ is divisible by 36. If $B$ is a prime number, find the value of $A$.

The operator $\wedge$ acts on two integers to give the following outcomes:

$$4\wedge8=2412,\quad5\wedge9=2812,\quad1\wedge7=1618,\quad2\wedge3=103.$$

What is the value of $7\wedge8$?

An election for the mayoralty post consists of 5 candidates: A, B, C, D, and E. There are 1400 eligible voters. In the middle of the manual count, A got 300 votes, B got 154 votes, C got 194 votes, D got 281 votes, and E got 266 votes. There were also 9 invalid votes. What is the least number of votes that A needs to get in order to ensure that he wins the mayoralty post?

In the diagram, $ABC$ is a right-angled triangle with $\angle C=90^\circ$. Points $D$ and $E$ are on the segments $BC$ and $AC$ such that $BD:DC=2:3$, $AE:EC=3:2$, $AD=4$, and $BE=\sqrt{10}$. Find the value of $57\times AB^2$.

Two-way roads are constructed between Town A, Town B and Town C. It is given that the number of direct roads between any two of the towns is at least three and at most ten. One can go from Town A to Town C directly or via Town B in a total of 33 different ways. One can go from Town B to Town C directly or via Town A in a total of 23 different ways. In how many ways can one go from Town B to Town A?

In the following cryptarithm, all the different letters stand for different digits.

$$\begin{array}{ccccc} & & W & I & N\\ +& S & A & S & M & O\\ \hline & M & E & D & A & L\end{array}$$

If $N=4$ and $M=6$, find the value of the sum $M+E+D+A+L$.
